issue.title: Two bob-mac-capture close tests fail once the suite compiles (masked by bob-cli-3m)
issue.description:
Found by bob-cli-3u.land (epic bob-cli-3u landing; not proposed by a phase) while running the bob-mac-capture suite on a macOS 26 / Swift 6.3.2 **Command Line Tools-only** Mac. That Mac has no XCTest.framework, so the suite ran under a throwaway XCTest stand-in: assertions, XCTUnwrap and XCTSkip, plus a generated runner `dlopen`ed from the SwiftPM test bundle. The stand-in was never committed. The same two failures appear identically at pre-epic 68ed00d and at 680e17f plus the bob-cli-3u landing fixes. Under the stand-in, 622 CaptureCore, 16 install-helper and ~500 panel tests otherwise pass.

CI never reaches them: bob-cli-3m's compile error at `CapturePanelModelTests.swift:2024` breaks the Test step first. These failures will surface as soon as bob-cli-3m lands, so fix them together or right after it.

1. `Tests/CaptureCoreTests/CapturePomodoroClosePresentationTests.swift::testShortAliasPreviewShowsDefaultTaskOne` (from aa1e73a) fails at line 1625, `XCTAssertTrue(parked.accessibilityLabel.contains("Parked"))`.
   - Root cause: `CapturePomodoroClosePresentation.swift:549` (1056569) builds `"Task N, <text>, <transition>, parked, not carried to the next Pomodoro"`, with a lowercase `parked`, and `String.contains` is case-sensitive.
   - Fix: decide which spelling VoiceOver should read (the row's visible badge is `"Parked · not carried"`), then align the test or the label.
   - Re-check the rest of that test after the fix, because XCTest continues after the first failure.
2. `Tests/BobMacCaptureTests/CapturePanelModelTests.swift::testMixedDraftSurfacesBobDiagnostic` (from 68ed00d) times out at line 2628 waiting for `previewState == .failed`.
   - fake-bob answers `capture-parse` for `=x\n- foo\n- 2 bar` with `Tests/Fixtures/pomodoro-close-parse-log-mixed.json`. That payload is `ok: true`, mode `pomodoro_close`, `needs: []`, plus an error-severity `invalid_pomodoro_close` diagnostic.
   - The panel model apparently does not turn that diagnostic into `.failed`. Either it proceeds to a `capture --dry-run` that fake-bob has no branch for, or it ignores error diagnostics.
   - Fix: determine which, and fix the model if real Bob behaves this way, or the fixture/fake-bob if not.

Verify with the real macOS CI run (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`), not only locally.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Both fail identically at pre-epic 68ed00d and at 680e17f with landing fixes. The first is a deterministic case-sensitive string assertion: the source label says 'parked' and the test expects 'Parked'. The second times out on the same fixed fake-bob payload every run.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-3u.land ran the full Mac suite outside CI and found two deterministic failures that CI cannot see behind bob-cli-3m's compile error; fixing only bob-cli-3m would leave Mac CI red.
